description: Same 16-digit shape as the known-valid Visa test number 4111111111111111, with the last digit changed 1->2 so the Luhn checksum fails. Digits are written with NO separators (fully contiguous), so even though CARD's validate() vetoes it, no other pattern (PHONE/AADHAAR) can grab an internal substring either -- both require a non-digit boundary that a fully contiguous digit run never provides internally. Expected: zero spans.
